comment: The concurrency table of design spec 10.4, one entry per row (plan Task 21). Every case runs two
transactions, A and B, interleaved as plan call C12 orders them: start A, start B, commit B,
commit A. A side runs its steps when it starts and commits later; its outcome is 'committed' or
the class of the error its steps or its commit signalled, with protoBaseST's names (PB...).
setup runs in one transaction on a new database 'cc' (or, with the step ['vector database'],
on a copy of the conformance database vector, whose database is 'db'). The steps:
['read root', r]                     get the root r (records its token, absence included)
['set root', r, v]                   set the root r to v; in setup, v may be
{'dict': {k: v}}, {'list': [v]} or {'set': [e]}
['blind dict set root', r, k, v]     set r to a new Dictionary {k: v}, r unread (merges)
['replace', r, k, v]                 set r to a new Dictionary {k: v} with replace: true
['list set', r, v]                   set r to a new List [v], r unread
['set add', r, e], ['set remove', r, e]
set r to a new Set with e added (removed), r unread
['new mutable', m, v], ['set mutable', m, v], ['remove mutable', m]
the mutable-cell operations (set and remove blind)
['reuse committed', r, k1, v1, k2, v2]
before the side's transaction starts, commit r as a new
Dictionary {k1: v1} (a blind write); then, in the
transaction, set r to that committed value with k2 -> v2
expected holds ProtoBase's outcome (the reference) and the final contents of the roots and
cells listed in roots and mutables, in the dump notation of py_case.py and _case_ops.st:
absent, 1, 'text', {'k': v} (sorted keys), [v], #{e} (sorted), <object> for a DBObject.
protobasest, present only where protoBaseST documents a refusal (design spec 7.4), holds its
outcomes with protoST as A (st_as_a), with Python as A (py_as_a) and with two protoST actors
(actors); every other case must give the reference in all three.
